title: Run 158 re-measures the maintained packaged-regression gate on the unchanged candidate and confirms it is not hermetic: the 25s child budget AND the foreground-dependent synthetic input both make the verdict a function of ambient host and desktop contention, not of artifact behaviour
why_this_finding_exists: The controller handed this dispatch the previous run's status ORCHESTRATION_RECOVERY_REQUIRED (0155-W57-run-normalized.json) with no machine-result block, and canonical state.json shows T05 completed with empty detail and empty evidence. The packaged verdict was therefore unattested in any validated dispatch. T05 was re-run from scratch in this phase instance rather than being read off the prior prose.

correction_to_the_run_155_finding.claim_in_run_155: the same unmodified code at the harness's own 240s constant returned result=PASS with 20/20 checks in 3m37.98s
correction_to_the_run_155_finding.measured_in_run_158: FAIL 14/20 in 9.62s with runtime='keyboard_input:foreground_lost_after_terminal_click', runtime_phase=0 and zero input events delivered
correction_to_the_run_155_finding.consequence: The 240s budget is not a demonstrated cure. It changes the failure signature from 'child never finished' to 'child finished fast and aborted at phase 0 because it could not obtain foreground and no synthetic input was delivered'. The gate therefore has TWO non-hermetic inputs - the hardcoded 25s child budget and the absolute-coordinate foreground/input expectation - and both track ambient conditions rather than the artifact.
correction_to_the_run_155_finding.comparison_to_the_last_green_run: artifacts/wave_W57/W57_PACKAGED_SMOKE_8BA80453_PASS.json (2026-09-28 01:06) is PASS 20/20, exit 0, runtime_phase 4, sendinput_events 36, ssh_input_chars 18, dom_input_events keydown 18, on the identical artifact SHA-256. The artifact is therefore demonstrably capable of 20/20 on this host; what is not hermetic is the harness measurement.

contaminant_ruled_out_first.conclusion: The stale topmost WerFault signature is absent. A second, different and larger desktop-contention source is present instead, measured below.

ambient_contention_measured.sibling_project_gui_on_desktop: python.exe pid 61912 = D:\Projeler\image-process-para-2\src\main.py owning a visible wxWindowNR window titled 'IMPI'
ambient_contention_measured.why_this_matters: The 20-check gate drives the artifact with absolute-coordinate clicks (terminal_click [770,544] in the green run) and requires the artifact to own the foreground. With ~20 competing visible windows, a sibling project's wx GUI, three concurrent agent programs and a terminal holding foreground, foreground_request_accepted is false and zero input events reach the WebView. The verdict is then a property of the operator's desktop, not of the shipped bundle.
